title: Live room in the tab: Run, Hosting, Stop keeps the result, close asks
covers: SessionTabs live room, TabResults, close rules, hosting status in the title bar
context: After Run the tab shows the live room: status bar, address, seed and files. The tab dot goes Generating, Hosting, Stopped. Stop keeps the tab with the result and the buttons Run again, Open in History and Close tab. Closing a tab that hosts asks first.
changed: live/close-tab: Stop the room and close, Cancel the run and close

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: session
setup.text: Any saved session with one player of A Link to the Past, for example Setup check.

steps: Open Sessions, pick the session and press Run. In the tab press Run. The dot goes to Generating (it pulses) and then Hosting. The lobby cards give way to the live room with the status bar, the Address, the Seed and the Files.
The title bar now shows a status Hosting followed by the session name. Open it with Show the hosting room: the tab comes to the front.
Press the x of the tab. A question titled Stop the room and close opens. Press Cancel (or dismiss it): the tab stays and the room keeps hosting.

Press Stop in the status bar of the live room and confirm. The dot turns Stopped. The tab stays and a note reads The room is stopped. Its seed and files stay in History. with the buttons Run again, Open in History and Close tab.
Press Open in History. History opens on this run with the seed and files. Go back to the tab.
Press Run again. A new tab for the same session opens in the Lobby phase.
Close both tabs with Close tab or the x. No question is asked: nothing hosts and nobody joined.
pass: The tab moves from the lobby to the live room, and the dot reads Generating, Hosting, then Stopped.
Closing a hosting tab asks Stop the room and close, and Cancel keeps everything running.
Stop keeps the tab with the result and the three buttons. Run again opens a new lobby tab.
fail: A hosting tab closes with no question, or Cancel stops the room anyway.
Stop closes the tab and loses the result.
Run again hosts a room at once without showing the lobby.
notes: Closing a tab while the seed is being made asks Cancel the run and close. It is hard to hit by hand, so it is optional.
Closing a lobby tab where a player has joined asks Close the lobby. The test Session tab: a second client joins can show it.
